pair_match: TDM axiale. Normale : homme de 21 ans, coupe abdominale. La légende de l'hématome ne nomme pas le sexe. Série sans injection et ulcère pénétrant absents. Partiel.

normal.author: Mikael Häggström, M.D.
normal.note: Même coupe normale que IMG-159. Aorte de calibre habituel à ce niveau.
normal.caption_source: Computed tomography of the abdomen and pelvis, performed as a contrast CT, here presented in the axial plane with 3 mm slice thickness. It shows normal anatomy, with no injuries. The subject is a 21 year old male who had blunt trauma to the upper abdomen during motocross.

patho.author: Yuan-Jang Hsu, Pin-Ru Chen, Yu-Sen Lin et al.
patho.note: Figure 1, Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery 2014. A–C : dissection un mois avant. D–F : hématome à l'admission. Pas de flèche d'auteur. Pas de nom lisible.
patho.caption_source: Transverse CT scan showed hematoma formation in the descending aorta. (A-C) One month before admission, descending aortic dissection was diagnosed and the patient was treated with medical therapy. (D-F) At admission, as compared to the prior CT scan an intramural hematoma with false lumen was noted.

arrows.label: Hématome de l'aorte descendante
arrows.evidence: (D-F) At admission, as compared to the prior CT scan an intramural hematoma with false lumen was noted.
arrows.definition: Épaississement pariétal de l'aorte descendante décrit comme un hématome. La définition (croissant hyperdense sans injection, sans ulcère) n'a pas été relue, et ce cliché est injecté.
